english.title: Attach pipe or apparatus without consent of water supply licensee
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of **(..SPECIFY LICENSEE..), the water supply licensee, attached

(A)_[a pipe]_
(B)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..),]_

to a pipe which was vested in a water supply licensee and was used in connection with the carrying on by a licensee of the activities authorised by a licensee's licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(3A)(a) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
